evals.name: Basic cva documentation
evals.prompt: Generate JSDoc for the cva function from @anitrove/unstyled
evals.expected_output: JSDoc with @description, @param, @returns, @template, and @example sections showing cva usage

assertions.text: The generated JSDoc includes a @description section explaining what cva does
The generated JSDoc includes @param documentation for the cva parameter with details about base, variants, defaultVariants, and compoundVariants
The generated JSDoc includes @returns documentation describing the returned object structure
The generated JSDoc includes @example sections with real usage examples from tests

evals.name: precompileStyles documentation
evals.expected_output: JSDoc with proper @param documentation for the style parameter and @example showing simple and complex usage

assertions.text: The @param documentation explains what PreCompiledStyles contains
The @returns documentation describes PreCompiledStyles and its .styles property
The @example section shows different usage patterns including simple styles and media queries

evals.name: mapValue documentation
evals.expected_output: JSDoc for mapValue showing how it transforms Value types with @param and @template documentation

assertions.text: The @template parameter A is documented with its constraint
The @param value documentation explains both simple values and media query objects
The @param fn documentation explains the transformation function signature
The @example section shows transformation of both simple values and media query objects

evals.name: Type documentation
evals.expected_output: JSDoc for the Properties interface explaining the CSSProperties extension and custom properties support

assertions.text: The JSDoc includes a @description explaining the interface purpose
The JSDoc includes @example showing how to use the interface

evals.name: Complex cva with compound variants
evals.prompt: Generate JSDoc that includes examples showing compound variants usage
evals.expected_output: JSDoc with examples demonstrating base variants, simple variants, and compound variants

assertions.text: The JSDoc includes an example showing compound variants
The JSDoc includes an example showing variants with media queries
The JSDoc includes an example showing usage with Box component

evals.name: Documentation consistency
evals.prompt: Review all generated JSDoc and ensure consistent formatting across all functions
evals.expected_output: All generated JSDoc should follow the same format with consistent parameter ordering and example style

assertions.text: All generated JSDoc uses the same @param parameter ordering
All generated JSDoc uses backticks for code blocks
All generated JSDoc includes relevant examples from test files
